prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case — the right attorney depends on your injuries, the facts, whether the trucker’s employer or a trucking company is involved, and whether you need a trial-ready firm with resources for complex liability and regulatory work.

How to find the best personal-injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident
- Look for truck-specific experience: attorneys who handle commercial-vehicle/trucking cases regularly and know FMCSA rules, hours-of-service logs, maintenance/inspection records and trucking company liability issues.
- Trial and resources: large trucking cases often require accident reconstructionists, investigators, medical experts and the financial ability to litigate. Make sure the lawyer has those resources and trial experience.
- Track record: ask about prior settlements/verdicts in truck cases, especially amounts and whether they went to trial.
- Credentials and reputation: board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (if applicable), AV Preeminent (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, peer reviews and client reviews help.
- Communication and fees: confirm how they communicate, expected timeframes, and contingency fee details and costs.
- Local experience: a Dallas lawyer who knows local judges, defense firms and court procedures can be an advantage.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many truck-accident cases have you handled? How many this year?
- Have you tried any trucking cases to verdict? Can you share examples/outcomes?
- Do you handle cases on contingency? What percentage and what costs will I be responsible for?
- What experts and investigators do you use?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (the lead attorney or an associate)?
- How will you communicate case status and how often?

Immediate steps you should take now
- Get medical care and document all injuries/treatment.
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, scene, injuries; witness names/contacts; truck number/license plate.
- Obtain the police crash report.
- Avoid giving recorded statements to insurers (insurer for the at-fault party or their company) without an attorney.
- Keep all bills, wage-loss documentation, repair estimates and correspondence.

Where to look for top Dallas attorneys
- State Bar of Texas lawyer referral service or Dallas Bar Association
- Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (look for peer/client ratings and comments)
- Local trial firms known for catastrophic/transportation cases

If you want, I can:
- Pull together a short list of well-regarded Dallas truck-accident attorneys/firms (with publicly available credentials and contact info) — tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood.
- Help you draft questions to ask during consultations.
- Advise on preserving evidence specific to your situation.

Which would you prefer, and can you share a few details about your crash (date, injuries, whether the truck is commercial/owned by a company, any police report)?
